title: Building the band: Dodds, Dutrey, Tubby Hall, Minor Hall, Lil Hardin
summary: Garland lists how he gathered Johnny Dodds, Noah Dutrey, the Hall brothers and Lil Hardin, with Joe Oliver coming in. The transcript has an ASR loop of 'Oakland' in the middle.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Then, uh, Johnny Dodds come in town. We got a hold of Johnny Dodds. Nora Dutre was in the neighborhood. He used to come into Chicago and he'd come sit in with us. So, uh, Boyd H. Williams opened up the, uh, the, opened up this club on 34th Street, uh, Oakland And Joe comes in, all right? Joe gets Bill Johnson to play bass with him. He got a woman named Lottie, she was playing violin, and some other woman was playing piano. Bursar? No, no. We didn't get a whole bunch until we come out here. Oh, I did. First of all. Then we began to get in our band together. See, we got our heads together that we're going to get our aunt group. We finally got Noah Dutrae and Johnny, you see, myself. Ram come in town, I had Baby Hall play with me, his brother. Ram come in, he was running on the railroad. You mean Tubby Hall? Tubby was playing with me, but Ram was running on the SP, the dishwasher there. Oh, yeah? Yeah. He was cooking dishwash in the house. Uh-huh. Then, after we got the bunch together, after he went to war, to the army, he come back. I takes Ram. Then finally Joe goes away. He gets all together, organized our regular group. We had Noah Dutrae, we had Jimmy Pilar, Johnny Dodge, Lil, I got Lil to play with me, Lil Hardin, her name. Lil Armstrong, she's waking for Mrs. Jones. She's music, you know, demonstrating. Yes. I had a job on the west side in Chicago, and I asked her, could I use her for that night? I said, oh no, you want to steal my girl? I said, oh, this one for the night, they don't want no guitar. Lil kept playing guitar, you see. The man said, you better get your piano to play if you want to stay around here and wait. You can be playing away because you'll get your piano to play. I kept on listening to Lil Hardin.
